profile.headline: Software Engineer at FanDuel
profile.summary:
I have a vibrant spirit and prefer happiness and to make others feel happy too! I began my career with a growth mindset I have learned different skillsets based on the requirements of various technical projects. I utilize computer science fundamentals and learn new technologies in various development environments. 

Communication, problem solving, prioritization, and quality assurance are the values I live by as an engineer. I always bring positivity, enthusiasm, and a cheerful spirit to the team!

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Building and testing features to successfully fetch and process sport data from remote data providers.
- Build new features on the full-stack for an internal software maintenance and incident recovery tool.
- Test new features independent of QA
positions.insights: Skills: API Development · Python (Programming Language) · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Java · SQL · GitHub

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- I wrote code in Java and Php to develop Chegg's textbook ordering system software. I used python and SQL to write data manipulation scripts. 
- I participated in “On Call” rotation to resolve incidents within my team's services.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Java · SQL · GitHub

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
I was offered an opportunity to conduct undergraduate research with Dr. Yolanda Rankin. I pursued this research opportunity within human computer interaction, to explore language learning video games. As a result of my academic performance and research interest, I received the Clare Booth Luce Research Fellowship. 
I assisted in research play test sessions to gather survey data from students who played language learning video games and performed data analysis. 
We discussed findings based on the analysis and I wrote a research paper describing our findings. I also presented these finding in an oral presentation during Spelman College’s annual research day.

positions.title: Enterprise Architect
positions.description: I communicated with other employees and gathered their software tool ratings from an internal evaluation system. At the conclusion of the internship I presented my findings involving the software tools that were the most and least effective based on data analysis of employee ratings.

honors.title: Google Anita Borg Memorial Scholarship
honors.description: I was awarded the Google Anita Borg Memorial scholarship based on my academic merit, leadership, and involvement in the woman in tech community.

honors.title: SMART DOD Scholarship
honors.description: The Science, Mathematics, and Research for Transformation (SMART) scholarship funded my senior year of college and allowed me to serve as a civilian Computer Scientist.
honors.issuer: Issued by U.S Department of Defense  · Jun 2016
